Virtual Model, Real Product

Virtual Models Styling Art Direction Video Editing Retouching

Virtual Model, Real Product pairs AI-generated models with real garments, footwear, and eyewear — every product is genuine, styled and shot as if for a real campaign, while the model wearing it is AI generated. The result reads like straightforward fashion photography, letting brands show product on a model without a physical shoot.
